name: Killer In The Keep Five Game Level Progression Calculator
algorithm: Add event XP to cumulative XP.
Find the highest threshold reached, but advance at most one Game Level for a single resolved event.
A valid natural-20, clue, or milestone trigger may also advance at most one Game Level.
After Game Level 5, convert additional XP to score or account rewards only.
